mapper.sql: FROM community_follow f WHERE f.follower_id = #{viewer} AND f.following = 1 AND ((LEFT(f.target_key,1) = 'u' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM user_account u WHERE CONCAT('u',u.id) = f.target_key AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.account_status = 1)) OR (LEFT(f.target_key,1) = 'b' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM community_blogger b WHERE CONCAT('b',b.id) = f.target_key AND b.enabled = 1))) AND (EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM user_account u LEFT JOIN user_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE f.target_key = CONCAT('u',u.id) AND LOCATE(#{keyword},COALESCE(NULLIF(p.nickname,''),'社区用户'))>0) OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM community_blogger b LEFT JOIN user_profile bp ON bp.user_id = b.user_id AND bp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE f.target_key = CONCAT('b',b.id) AND LOCATE(#{keyword},CASE WHEN b.user_id IS NULL THEN b.nickname ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(bp.nickname,''),'社区用户') END)>0))
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM user_account WHERE id = #{viewer} AND is_deleted = 0 AND account_status = 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_follow(follower_id,target_key,following) VALUES(#{viewer},#{targetKey},#{following}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE following = #{updatedFollowing},updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE community_follow SET following = 0,updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE follower_id = #{viewer} AND target_key IN ( SELECT CONCAT('b',id) FROM community_blogger WHERE user_id = #{targetUser}) AND following = 1
